_about: Four-slide product infographics (01 product photo, 02 Who is it for?, 03 What's inside?, 04 How to use). Text comes only from the genuine pack, the client's product sheet (Product details.docx), the original beingyoualways.com listing, or — for how.guide 'general' — conservative category-common steps. status 'ready' = every slide verified by the client; 'preview' = slides 02–03 verified, slide 04 is a general guide pending client approval (shown in the storefront preview, flagged in admin); 'draft' = admin only, previous gallery stays public. Source layouts: design/gallery-slides (run build.py).
